create_SHRotator: create an SHRotator instance with a rotation matrix and degree to transform spherical harmonics coefficients
run_get_sh1: run get_sh1 to compute the degree-1 spherical harmonics rotation matrix from a 3x3 rotation matrix
run_get_sh2: run get_sh2 to compute the degree-2 spherical harmonics rotation matrix from a degree-1 SH matrix
run_get_sh3: run get_sh3 to compute the degree-3 spherical harmonics rotation matrix from degree-1 and degree-2 SH matrices
run_get_sh4: run get_sh4 to compute the degree-4 spherical harmonics rotation matrix from degree-1, degree-2, and degree-3 SH matrices
